innovations.name: Healthcare
innovations.what: Medicare's final 2027 physician fee schedule (released Nov 4) kept the rename of AI software codes to Software as a Medical Service, but the published summaries show no new AI payment rates. It also cut the conversion factor to $32.9548 for doctors in alternative payment models and $32.6286 for the rest, from $33.5675 and $33.4009, effective Jan 1, 2027.
innovations.for_you: No action. The payment path for AI reads is named but not yet priced, so AI diagnostics stays at early adoption. TEM has a long term point at 61.51 (buypoints.json, Nov 19); nothing here changes it.
